content.user_title: Create Pull Requests with Clear Summaries
content.value_statement: Preparing a pull request can miss branch checks, summary details, or test notes. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through a consistent GitHub PR workflow.
actual_capabilities: Checks the current git branch before PR creation.
Reviews git status and commits since the main branch.
Pushes the current branch to the remote origin.
Builds a PR description with summary and test plan sections.
Creates a GitHub pull request with gh pr create.
Reports the PR URL, title, and target branch after completion.
limitations: Requires git and GitHub CLI access in the repository.
Requires an authenticated gh session with permission to create pull requests.
Needs the correct main branch name before comparing commits.
Does not verify CI status or guarantee that tests passed.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Feature PR
use_cases.description: A developer can turn a completed feature branch into a reviewed GitHub pull request.

use_cases.title: Standardize Review Notes
use_cases.description: A maintainer can require consistent summaries and test plans before team review.

use_cases.title: Document Release Changes
use_cases.description: A release lead can create a PR that clearly lists changes and validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic PR
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner workflow for a ready branch.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the creating-pull-requests skill to create a pull request for my current branch.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Draft PR
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the creating-pull-requests skill to create a draft pull request with a clear summary and test plan.

prompt_templates.title: Target a Base Branch
prompt_templates.scenario: Open a PR against a non-default branch.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the creating-pull-requests skill to create a pull request against the release branch and include test notes.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Fully Labeled PR
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the creating-pull-requests skill to create a PR, assign it to me, add labels, and report the final URL.

output_examples.input: Create a pull request for the current feature branch.
output_examples.output: The skill checks branch state, pushes the branch, creates the PR, and returns the PR URL and target branch.

output_examples.input: Open a draft PR with a test plan for reviewers.
output_examples.output: The skill creates a draft PR with summary bullets and a checklist of validation steps.

output_examples.input: Create a PR against a release branch and assign it to me.
output_examples.output: The skill targets the requested branch, applies assignment options, and reports the completed PR details.

best_practices: Confirm the main branch name before comparing commits.
Review the generated title, summary, and test plan before creating the PR.
Run relevant tests before asking the skill to create the pull request.
anti_patterns: Do not run it from a branch with unrelated or uncommitted changes.
Do not create a PR before confirming the remote repository and target branch.
Do not leave the test plan empty when reviewers need validation context.

faq.question: Does this skill create pull requests automatically?
faq.answer: It guides the agent through git and gh CLI commands that create a GitHub pull request.

faq.question: Which tools does it require?
faq.answer: It requires git and the GitHub CLI in a repository with suitable authentication.

faq.question: Can it create draft pull requests?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents the draft option for GitHub pull request creation.

faq.question: Can it target a specific base branch?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes an option for selecting the target branch.

faq.question: Does it run tests before creating a PR?
faq.answer: No. It includes a test plan section, but test execution is outside this skill.

faq.question: Is it useful with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows for PR preparation.
